BiblicalUsage: ʻEqrôwn was a city of the Philistines, on the coastal plain. The name occurs 20 times, most often in 1 Samuel. There is no People profile for it, because it is a place, not a person.
TheologicalSignificance: I take ʻEqrôwn as it stands: a place named in the record, a small mark on the map. That is enough reason to slow down and notice the name rather than skip it.
RelatedEvents: The Ark Captured and Returned; Elijah and Ahaziah's Messengers
